newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador Q1 current account deficit up 19.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador Q1 current account deficit up 19.1 pct.

text.p: Ecuador's first-quarter current account deficit widened by 19.1 percent to $106 million compared with the same period of 1996, the central bank said on Wednesday.
In the year-earlier quarter, the current account deficit stood at $89 million.
The shortfall for the 1997 quarter reflected deficits in the services balance, which grew to $401 million from $358 million in the year-earlier quarter.
In 1996, Ecuador registered a current account surplus of $293 million.
